features.title: Open-source ANC engine for Android
features.what: A native Android app that emits phase-inverted audio waves to neutralize room hums.
features.evidence_quote: An open-source Android Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) engine

features.title: Seven-second ambient scan
features.what: The microphone captures seven seconds of room audio, then the FFT locks onto the strongest drone.
features.evidence_quote: AhSilence captures a 7-second ambient audio sample to detect the dominant low-frequency hum (e.g., AC units).

features.title: Manual phase dial for Bluetooth delay
features.what: A three hundred sixty degree phase dial lets the user hand-trim wave timing against headset latency.
features.evidence_quote: Use the Phase Calibrator dial to manually compensate for the delay.

features.title: Targets steady low-frequency hums
features.what: The detector goes after persistent low-frequency drones such as air conditioners, not voices.
features.evidence_quote: persistent, low-frequency hums (such as AC units or electrical drones)

features.title: The author admits imperfection
features.what: The support FAQ itself opens with the admission that the cancellation is not perfect.
features.evidence_quote: The cancellation isn't perfect. What can I do?
features.risk: Single-tone cancellation only: multi-frequency and automatic Bluetooth compensation sit on the roadmap.

features.title: Fully offline
features.what: The app makes no network calls, collects no data, and runs the loop entirely on-device.
features.evidence_quote: zero network calls, zero data collection, zero telemetry

risks: Single-tone cancellation only: multi-frequency and automatic Bluetooth compensation sit on the roadmap.
